description: Per-repo inventory sweep (KB-406, ADR-0015 wave 1): one deterministic collect step enumerates open dependabot PRs + per-PR CI verdicts, govulncheck/osv advisory state, CodeQL open-alert counts and protection ruleset state for a bound org/repo set, and emits one normalized inventory.json artifact under the sweep root. All traffic authenticates with the workflow GitHub identity; sweep artifacts live on the data lane.
